items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Quinn Wilson multiple times, and the interviewee responds with agreement ('Right', 'Yeah', 'Uh-huh') but provides no personal anecdotes or direct interaction details regarding Quinn Wilson.

ctx.x: Yeah, so, I mean, it was just an instinct, a feeling, you know?
Quinn Wilson -- I had one of these interviews with Quinn Wilson a few months ago, and he grew up in the same neighborhood as Lionel Hampton.
